name: Allen Hulburt
role: Discoverer of the Lost Cabin mines in J. S. Warn's account
bio: Allen Hulburt was the uncle of J. S. Warn, who in a June–July 1885 Cow Boy serial named him the original discoverer of the Lost Cabin gold mines in the Big Horn mountains. In Warn's account Hulburt was driven out by Indians, buried the gold he could not carry, and later led an expedition back as Captain Hulburt.
